text.style: font-family: Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; fill: rgb(108, 117, 125); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Each panel resumes training from the finished global policy and tries to recover Boxing, the one task the
sequence lost. All three were discarded as net-negative. Boxing (blue) moves between +2 and +36 while
Breakout and Q*bert give up far more, Q*bert alone losing 4,424 in the middle panel. Note each panel has its
own vertical scale. The +625 on Space Invaders in the first panel is evaluation noise on a single greedy-100
run rather than a gain, and it does not survive the longer probes. A forgotten task cannot be patched after
the fact, which is the argument for holding retention during the sequence rather than repairing it at the end.
